description: Level 1 (Dusty Hollow): named for an efficient $80k win, no vehicle ever bought -- but #553 makes drill_hole a queued, vehicle-gated action, so drilling now costs real vehicle purchases where it previously cost none (still zero HAULING vehicles -- debris_hauler/rock_digger/rock_fragmenter/building_destroyer -- so 'no hauling infrastructure means no delivery ever succeeds' still holds). The real trajectory goes further than a missed $80k target: pattern 1 lands and blasts (killing its entire 4-person crew, exactly as tutorial-playthrough.json's own precedent), and pattern 2's fresh crew fully lands all 25 of its own holes before wellbeing (crashed by sustained real-time drilling work with no living_quarters ever built -- EmployeeNeeds.ts, not the dead crew's morale: computeAverageMorale (Employee.ts) already averages only the LIVING roster) stays at 0 long enough for WorkerRevolt.ts to end the level in a permanent revolt -- see the Findings on the campaign status step for the full trajectory. #586-followup (this session's own fix, real interaction-mode CI failure): pattern 1 used to carry ~100 ticks of dead post-drilling tick padding before its own charge step (holes finished landing at real tick 170, charge wasn't issued until tick 270, sandbox-confirmed) -- long enough that wellbeing crashed to 0 and stayed there past WorkerRevolt.ts's REVOLT_TICKS (120) window *during pattern 1's own charge wait*, before its `sequence`/`blast` steps ever ran; that is what the interaction-mode click failure on `#bs-blast-panel [data-step="3"]` actually was -- the level-end overlay was already up, not a transient click race. Removing the dead padding lets pattern 1's charge/sequence/blast complete at wellbeing 0 but only ~70 ticks into the 120-tick revolt window, comfortably before it fires; the revolt (still this file's real ending) now lands during pattern 2 instead, after its own 25 holes are already drilled. The two survey steps (core_sample at (10,10), seismic at (20,20)) that gate the survey-confidence-overlay screenshot are untouched command-for-command, interaction-block-for-interaction-block from the version already confirmed via an inspected screenshot (not just source reading) to render the overlay genuinely -- the stale 'FAILS until GameRenderer wires survey overlay into syncFromContext()' warning this file previously carried is no longer true; a fresh interaction-mode run re-captures the same screenshots at whatever step index this longer file now gives them, not re-inspected as part of this #553 pass (command-mode only per this pass's own verification scope).
